== Description ==

[[Robbie Hendon]] (left, grey SWCCG Players Committee cap, grey tee, goatee, name tag), [[Logan Pietig]] (right, black UWL hoodie, brown hair, pink card sleeves, young), [[Amar Banger]] (mid-right, grey Vader/stormtrooper graphic tee, full dark beard), and [[Spencer Gosiaco]] (mid-left, Mariners cap, green/blue flannel) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
